title: Private trackers
description: One section per private tracker: the rules that bind it, and the numbers those rules make matter.

panels.title: Accounts below their own line
panels.description: Every tracker measured against its own threshold: TorrentLeech disables under 0.4, DigitalCore revokes leeching under 0.5, C411 blocks downloads under 0.8. Anything above zero means an account is on the wrong side of a wall.

targets.expr: count(((tracker_ratio or tracker_read_ratio) / tracker_min_ratio) < 1) or vector(0)

panels.title: Tightest headroom, and where
panels.description: The smallest amount of non-freeleech downloading left on any account, and which one it is. This is the number that decides what may be grabbed by hand.

panels.title: Obligations with the clock stopped
panels.description: Every tracker. A torrent that owes seeding time and is not announcing pays nothing off, and on DigitalCore one hour of silence is enough to be listed.

panels.title: TorrentLeech ratio
panels.description: Named because it is the only account under a deadline. Its line is 0.4.

panels.title: Grabs a day, all grabbers
panels.description: Across every enabled autobrr filter, read from autobrr itself rather than assumed. Each grab is locked on disk until its hit & run window closes, so this is a disk budget as much as a rate.

panels.title: Reading age
panels.description: tracker-control runs every 30 minutes. A stale reading looks exactly like a healthy account, which is why this is on the front row.

panels.title: Headroom
panels.description: Site figures where the account can be logged into, figures read by eye where it cannot.

panels.title: Ratio, per account
panels.description: The same figure each account's own section shows, so it cannot be misread as anything else. What differs per site is the colour, because each has a different wall: TorrentLeech disables under 0.4, DigitalCore revokes leeching under 0.5, C411 blocks downloads under 0.8. Red is below the line, orange is just above it, green is clear of it. The bar tops out at 1.5 so the accounts near their wall stay readable; the number beside it is always the true value. Sites with no ratio rule are absent by design.

panels.title: Seeding on disk
panels.description: What each tracker's torrents occupy locally.

panels.title: Uploaded, per the client
panels.description: The client's own count, which is not the site's accounting. Useful for comparing trackers, not for arguing with staff.

panels.title: Open hit and run obligations
panels.description: Measured from the client against each site's own rule, not read from the sites: the only H&R number any of them publishes here is DigitalCore's, and that one is read by eye. Normal for anything recent. Only the stopped-clock count is an emergency.

panels.title: Grabs a day, per tracker
panels.description: Zero means the filter exists and is switched off, which is different from having no grabber at all.

panels.title: Deadlines
panels.description: TorrentLeech's warning is the only deadline left. A probation or a suspension elsewhere would land in the same panel.

panels.title: Hours each torrent still owes
panels.description: Per torrent, per tracker, and whether its clock is running. A stopped clock on a torrent that still owes hours is the only row worth reacting to.

options.content:
**What disables the account**

| Rule | Value |
|---|---|
| Minimum ratio | **0.4**, then a warning, 7 days, and disabled |
| Hit & run | 240 h **or** ratio 1:1 per torrent |
| Uncleared H&R | **3 = account disabled** |
| Download slots | one, and a partial download occupies it |
| Freeleech | excluded from the download count |
| On being disabled | **the passkey is reset**: everything announces `unregistered` |

Seed goal here: **360 h / ratio 1.2**, above their requirement because their clock lags the client's.

**The healthiest account, and the one that pays for seeding**

| Rule | Value |
|---|---|
| Minimum ratio | **0.5**, then 5 days of ratio watch and leeching is revoked |
| Hit & run | starts at **10% downloaded**, clears at **5 days** or ratio 1:1 |
| Uncleared H&R | **5 = warning**, more = download ban |
| Whose clock counts | **the site's**. One hour without an announce and it is listed |
| Always free | **15 GB or larger**, and every new torrent's first 24 h |
| Leech bonus | 10 GB seeded = **1% off** every download; 1 TB = site-wide freeleech |

Seed goal here: **168 h / ratio 1.0**. Never modify their torrents: no extra trackers, no DHT, no PEX.

**The tightest account here, and the one nobody was watching**

| Rule | Value |
|---|---|
| Ratio to download | **0.8**. Below it, downloads are blocked |
| Signup credit | **50 GB** counted into the ratio, and it does not grow back |
| Hit & run | **disabled site-wide right now** |
| H&R when it returns | 72 h **or** ratio 1.0, after a 24 h grace period |
| H&R sanctions | 3 active block downloads, **5 strikes is a ban** |
| Cross-seeding | explicitly allowed |

Of its 52 GB of upload, **50 are the credit**: only 2.3 GB was ever really uploaded.

**Cartoons only, and everything is free right now**

| Rule | Value |
|---|---|
| Minimum ratio | none. Here the debt is **time** |
| Required seeding | **72 h per torrent**, within the first 10 days |
| Their own note | it is their strictest rule, "no exceptions" |
| Right now | **site-wide freeleech** until about 2026-09-30 |
| Content | animation, and strictly family friendly |
| Bonus | points for seeding, tripled on the daily feature |

Seed goal here: **96 h / ratio 1.0**, a third above what they ask for.

panels.title: Open obligations, per tracker
panels.description: Torrents that have not yet cleared their tracker's seed requirement, measured from qBittorrent against each site's rule. The client's clock runs ahead of the tracker's, by 26 to 118 h the last time the two were compared, so read this as a floor. Only the panel beside it is an emergency.

panels.title: Clock stopped, per tracker
panels.description: A torrent that owes seeding time and is not announcing pays nothing off. Flat at zero is the only acceptable shape here.

panels.title: Estimated leech bonus
panels.description: DigitalCore's own formula applied to what is seeding. Cross-seeds move this at no disk cost.
